input: Validated complete radroots_domain::Terms; all source snapshots and supply commitments remain unauthenticated claims.
canonicalization: RFC8785 subset with fixed ASCII schema keys, exact integer/quantity/time strings, safe unsigned numeric schema fields, unchanged Unicode and semantic array order.

independent_vectors.scope: Nine synthetic complete Terms byte/hash vectors plus exact-limit-plus-one rejection; ECMAScript canonicalization and Node.js SHA-256, without Rust encoder output.

retention.public_snapshot_serialization: Only explicitly public product, option and listing-revision snapshots may enter a temporary serde_json Value. Private fulfillment, selected/agreed prices, lot labels and supply risk use the protected writer directly.
retention.retained_bytes: EncodedTerms fixed object plus retained output buffer capacity; caller input and outer record/rumor allocations remain separate.
